<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Ship shape – every ship must be linked to a steel‑grade requirement case
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
_:ShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:hasSteelGradeRequirementCase ;
        sh:class nltl:steelGradeRequirementCase ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Each ship must have an associated steel‑grade requirement case for its hull plating (I2.12.1)." ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Steel‑grade requirement case shape – captures the inputs that drive the
#  lookup in Table 8 and the required hull‑structural steel grade.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
_:SteelGradeRequirementCaseShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:steelGradeRequirementCase ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:steelGradeRequirementCasePlating ;
        sh:class nltl:plating ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Plating component to which this steel‑grade requirement applies (I2.12.1)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:asBuiltPlateThickness ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node _:QuantityShape ;
        sh:description "As‑built plate thickness (quantity) required for the lookup." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:polarClass ;
        sh:class nltl:polarClassValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Polar class of the ship (I2.12.1)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:steelMaterialClass ;
        sh:class nltl:steelMaterialClassValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Material class of the structural members (I2.12.1)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:requiredHullStructuralSteelGrade ;
        sh:class nltl:steelGradeValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Required hull‑structural steel grade.  The grade must be **not less than** the grade given in Table 8 for the combination of thickness, polar class and material class (I2.12.1)." ;
        sh:message "Lookup against Table 8 (I2.12.1) is required; table data not provided in the current evidence set – constraint is recorded as unresolved." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:tableReference ;
        sh:class nltl:tableReferenceValue ;
        sh:hasValue nltl:iacsUrI2Table8 ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Explicit reference to IACS UR I2 Table 8 that supplies the allowable steel grades." ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Quantity shape – used for As‑built plate thickness
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
_:QuantityShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Numeric value of the quantity (e.g., plate thickness)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:in ( <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM> ) ;
        sh:description "Unit must be millimetre for plate thickness (as declared in the schema)." ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
#  Note on material ambiguity:
#  The concrete mapping from (as‑built thickness, polar class,
#  material class) to a minimum steel grade is defined in Table 8 of
#  I2.12.1.  Because Table 8 is not reproduced in the supplied source
#  fragments, the SHACL graph records the need for this lookup but
#  does not encode a definitive enumerated grade list.  Consumers must
#  supply the table data or a custom SPARQL‑based validator to complete
#  the compliance check.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
<END_SHACL>
